facts.text: The user asked the assistant to act like a car blogger.
The user said they would provide a video transcript.
The user asked for a blog post that reviews a car using information from the provided transcript and related information.
The user asked the blog post to summarize key takeaway points about the car.
The user asked the blog post to be SEO optimized.
The user asked the blog post to be optimized for reading time.
The user asked the blog post to be convenient for readers to get valuable information.
The user asked the blog post to give readers an overview of the product mentioned in the blog post.
